disposition_reason: Supports a statistical association between soil gallium and soil microbial communities. Does not support any effect on the human gut microbiome, and correlation does not show cause.

study.method: Soil chemistry was measured alongside amplicon sequencing of bacterial and fungal communities; associations were tested with Mantel tests and random forest models.

regulatory_or_exposure: Soil gallium 10.24 to 27.76 mg/kg across contamination levels
